SELECT s.salon_id AS salonId, s.owner_id AS ownerId, s.salon_name AS salonName, s.address, s.phone_number AS phoneNumber, s.description, s.average_rating AS averageRating, s.image_url AS imageUrl, MIN(se.price) AS minimumPrice, w.created_at AS wishlistCreatedAt FROM Wishlists w JOIN Salons s ON s.salon_id = w.salon_id LEFT JOIN Services se ON se.salon_id = s.salon_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY w.wishlist_id, s.salon_id, s.owner_id, s.salon_name, s.address, s.phone_number, s.description, s.average_rating, s.image_url, w.created_at ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
